reports.title: Performance Food Group Company Reports First-Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: For the second quarter of fiscal 2027, PFG expects net sales to be in a range of approximately $17.0 billion to $17.2 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $490 million to $510 million.

For the full fiscal year 2027, PFG continues to expect net sales to be in a range of approximately $72.5 billion to $73.0 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $2.125 billion to $2.225 billion. The guidance range for the full fiscal year includes the impact of a 53rd week.
